private_exact_packet.required_use: Use only for authorized local reconciliation; recapture after coordinated quiescence before activation.

safety.authorization: Evidence only. This index does not authorize deployment, restart, replay, database replacement, raw installation, settings overwrite, or plugin cache copying.

placeholder_resolution.${HOME}: Resolve from the selected service account at execution time.
placeholder_resolution.${STATE_HOME}: Resolve from the selected account's XDG state root at execution time.
placeholder_resolution.${SOURCE_TREE}: Resolve to the canonical verified WhatSoup source checkout selected for reconciliation.
placeholder_resolution.${INSTANCE}: Resolve from the authenticated local fleet registry.
placeholder_resolution.${PRIVATE_PACKET}: Resolve to private_exact_packet.path after validating root/file modes and SHA-256.

canonical_repository_provenance.note: These are public repository provenance identifiers, not claims about any installed host. Re-resolve full commits from canonical main before use.

required_capture.command_template: git -C "${SOURCE_TREE}" rev-parse HEAD origin/main; git -C "${SOURCE_TREE}" status --short --branch
stat and sha256sum each resolved unit, drop-in, wrapper, symlink target, manifest, and accepted local shim
open ${INSTANCE} database read-only; capture integrity, normalized schema, immutable migration history, recovery roots, and application-consistent backup/scratch-restore proof
capture ownership/modes and sanitized structural projections for config, settings, permissions, provider registry, and plugin state without values
after coordinated drain, prove no active provider request/process and no nonterminal inbound before migration or restore eligibility

comparison_policy.canonical_source: Compare against the reviewed merge commit and managed manifests.
comparison_policy.preserved_local_state: Preserve auth, config, settings, XDG data/state, private drop-ins, recovery roots, and backups unless an explicitly owned migration says otherwise.
comparison_policy.legacy_or_decoy_paths: Record and exclude; never import them as canonical state.
comparison_policy.unknown_or_mismatched_evidence: Stop activation and resolve through the owning migration/deployment path.
comparison_policy.refresh: Create a new private packet after coordinated quiescence; never edit this historical packet in place.

prohibited_actions: database, auth, settings, or state-directory replacement
publishing the private packet or derived local fingerprints
